text: When I get an answer wrong, does the card just drop down one level?
No, it goes straight back to box 1 so you can refresh the concept thoroughly.
That sounds strict, but I guess it stops me from forgetting tricky terms.
Exactly. And each correct recall moves it steadily up one box until it sticks.
Now I understand why the review schedule feels so reliable.
Mastering cards step by step builds lasting knowledge.
